about: What must not reach a public PR description unasked. Read by scripts/check-public-text.py before anything is pushed, and pinned with allow/refuse cases by tests/Unit/Skills/PrivateEvidencePatternsTest.php. Regexes stay in the subset Python re (compiled with re.ASCII) and PCRE read alike: an inline flag only at the start, no '~'.

patterns.why: an image: a screenshot an agent took shows whatever was on screen
a file uploaded to GitHub is public at that URL even after the PR is edited
inline file contents (an image or a recording) carried in the text itself
an absolute path on a workstation names its user and layout
